name: Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd
summary: Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd provides solid waste solutions in China. It engages in the investment, construction, and operation of waste incineration power generation, food waste recycling, wastewater treatment, sludge treatment, and rubber recycling. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Mizuda printing&dyeing group co.,Ltd and changed its name to Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd in January 2018. Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
